title: Countdown Studio
subtitle: Give time a little stage
description: Run several timers or count down to a date in another time zone. Full-screen stage mode, four themes and share links, all in your browser.
longDescription: A browser-only countdown studio for deadlines, launches, meetings and focus sessions. Run multiple timers side by side or put one on a full-screen stage. Time-zone-aware dates, themes and share links work without an account or server.
features: Multiple timers and time-zone-aware target dates
Four visual themes and shareable links
Local browser storage and completion sounds
